senses.zh_definition: Manjeet：人名，在马来西亚的人名记录中有实际用例；尚未确认其作为马来语普通词的词义。
senses.en_definition: Manjeet, a personal name attested in Malaysia; no Malay common-word meaning has been verified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang terdapat dalam rekod Malaysia; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 这是有用例支持的人名解读，并非已确认的 DBP 普通词条。正常书写应大写为 Manjeet。status 标为 unverified，以免将缺乏词典依据的项目标成官方词条。以下称谓组合与对话为教学示例，不代表已测定的高频搭配；人名用例见 [Malaysian Bar](https://www.malaysianbar.org.my/article/news/in-memoriam/in-memoriam/in-memoriam-manjeet-singh-dhillon)。

kat 在这里相当于标准语的 di。

etymology.historical_story: Malaysian records attest Manjeet as a personal name, including in the name of lawyer Manjeet Singh Dhillon. This establishes local name usage, but does not establish a Malay common noun or a particular literal meaning. Without a reliable name-etymology source, its deeper origin and pronunciation should remain unresolved rather than receive an invented historical explanation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Manjeet 放进通讯录来记：它在这里指人的名字；先认名字，再向本人确认读音。
